title: capcomd plugin manifest (capcomd.plugin/v1)
description: plugin.json: docs/spec/plugin-api.md §4. Generated from packages/plugin/src/manifest.ts; do not edit.

schema.description: The manifest schema id. A different id is refused (§12.2)

name.description: Plugin name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1-63 characters. Every contribution is namespaced by it

version.description: The plugin's own version. Built-ins use the capcomd package version

apiVersion.description: The plugin API major this plugin codes against (§12.1). The kernel refuses a major it doesn't serve

capcomd.description: A semver range of capcomd versions this plugin was tested with (§4.4). `*` is refused

module.description: A module path relative to the manifest, exporting `plugin: PluginModule` (§5.1). Built-ins only (§5.2)

command.description: argv the host starts, cwd = the plugin's root. `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` and `${PLUGIN_DATA}` are substituted (§9.2)

env.description: Extra environment, added to the filtered base (§9.2). Never a secret

scopes.description: harness.v1 scopes the plugin's own principal holds (§11.1). Default: none (the plugin can only answer hooks). `approve` is not grantable

provides.description: Capabilities this plugin provides: each `seam:` entry must match a `contributes.seams` entry (§4.6)

items.description: seam:sandbox/<name>, seam:agent/<name>, seam:forge/<name> (an implementation of a seam under that name), source:<name> (a trigger source, §16.3), context:<name> (a context provider a profile names, ADR-025 §3.1), plugin:<name> (another plugin, active), or kernel:<feature> (a kernel feature by its harness.v1 capability name)

requires.description: Capabilities that must be present and active before this plugin loads; a missing one fails resolution (§4.6)

items.description: seam:sandbox/<name>, seam:agent/<name>, seam:forge/<name> (an implementation of a seam under that name), source:<name> (a trigger source, §16.3), context:<name> (a context provider a profile names, ADR-025 §3.1), plugin:<name> (another plugin, active), or kernel:<feature> (a kernel feature by its harness.v1 capability name)

after.description: Plugins this one runs after, within its order (§6.3). An unknown name is ignored; a cycle fails resolution

items.description: Plugin name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1-63 characters. Every contribution is namespaced by it

hooks.description: Hook listeners by hook name (§6). One listener per hook per plugin

timeoutMs.description: The listener's deadline. May lower the hook's default; may never exceed the hook's maximum (§6.4). Default: the hook's default

failure.description: What a timeout, throw, crash or invalid result means: closed denies the operation (naming this plugin), open skips this listener. Gate hooks are always closed (declaring open is a validation error); other veto/modify hooks default to open; observe hooks are always open

changes.description: job.changed only: the change kinds this listener is called for (§6.6.19). Default: every kind. A plugin that only keeps a timer declares ["fired"], and the kernel then reads no running job's output for it

seams.description: Seam implementations (§7). At most one per kind

name.description: The implementation's name: what a run's `sandbox`, a profile's `harness.provider` or a repository's `merge.forge` selects (§7)

sources.description: Trigger sources this plugin feeds (§16.3); each must be listed in provides as source:<name>

name.description: The source's name (`github`, `slack`): what `ctx.triggers.emit` must name and what `triggers.sources.<name>` in config keys (§16.3)

context.description: Context providers (ADR-025 §3.1); each must be listed in provides as context:<name>

name.description: The provider's name: what a profile's `context.providers[].name` selects (`memory`, `groundray`)

kinds.description: The kinds of item it serves: fact (owned, sourced business knowledge) and memory (lessons a project learned)

name.description: The command group's first word, e.g. `slack`. Must not collide with a kernel command (§4.7.1)
Tool name without the prefix: registered as `capcomd_<plugin>_<name>` (§4.7.2)

scope.description: The caller's scope the route needs (not the plugin's)

kind.description: Descriptor kinds the app renders generically (§4.7.5; ADR-021's settings rows generalised)

events.description: Event types the plugin emits, without the prefix: emitted as `plugin.<name>.<type>` (§4.7.4). Lowercase words joined by _, starting with a letter (`verdict`, `thread_posted`), so `plugin.<name>.<type>` is a valid event type

config.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for `plugins.<name>` in config, inline or `{"$ref": "./config.schema.json"}`. Properties marked `"x-secret": true` take secret references, never values (§10.3). Properties marked `"x-per-run": true` may be overridden per run (§10.2)
